description: Four-pillar editing system: style matching, visual variety, continuity, and sound design

principles.rule: Editing style must match the audience's desired experience
principles.implication: Entertainment audience = rapid cuts. Hangout audience = long takes. Documentary = medium pacing with tension variation. Always ask: what experience does MY viewer want?

principles.rule: The core of editing is PACING — always as fast as possible for the genre
principles.implication: Even slow-paced nature documentaries cut to new clips every 5 seconds minimum.

principles.rule: Every moment should blend into the next seamlessly — editing should be invisible
principles.implication: Graphics must animate in. Focus point continuity must be maintained. Transitions should feel natural.

principles.rule: Vary the energy level — contrast between hype-edited sections and mellow A-roll forces viewers back into focus
principles.implication: Most underrated editing tip. Monotone energy = viewer fatigue regardless of content quality.

visual_variety.description: Maximize attention through diverse visual elements

footage_types.description: See and hear subject simultaneously. Personal, high attention. Use for important statements.
Extra footage separate from audio. Visual depiction of words. More interesting than A-roll — use as much as possible.
Lazy version of B-roll. Use sparingly.
Explain complex things quickly and clearly. High production value signal.

still_image_motion.description: Give movement to still clips to prevent visual stagnation
techniques: Abrupt scale changes to draw attention to important moments
Zoom into face during important A-roll statements

captions.rule: Only for emphasis, 3 words or less at a time
captions.anti_pattern: Do not use captions just to fill dead space

six_attention_guides.description: Six ways to guide viewer attention on images

techniques.name: animate_important_area
techniques.description: Animate the most important text/area — movement draws the eye

techniques.name: darken_blur_surrounds
techniques.description: Darken or blur surrounding areas to isolate the subject

techniques.name: color_shift
techniques.description: Shift hue to red (negative connotation) or yellow/green (positive)

techniques.name: graphic_indicators
techniques.description: Circles, arrows, underlines pointing to the subject

techniques.name: glow_effect
techniques.description: Make the subject glow to separate it from background

techniques.name: scale_position
techniques.description: Scale and position adjustments to emphasize the subject

six_attention_guides.automation_hint: Map these to storyboard segment intensity levels. High tension = techniques 1,2,3. Reveals = 4,5. Calm context = 6 only.

visual_continuity.description: Make editing invisible through seamless transitions

rules.description: In the last frame of clip 1 and first frame of clip 2, the viewer's eyes should be in roughly the same screen position
rules.consequence_if_violated: Jarring jump — viewer's eyes have to search for new focal point

rules.description: Graphics must move into the frame (animate in) or use a sound effect to explain their appearance
rules.consequence_if_violated: Graphics pop in from nowhere — breaks immersion

rules.description: Use full-screen transitions for section/chapter changes
Deliberately break continuity OCCASIONALLY for attention-grabbing jolts
rules.when: Major reveals, shocking moments, tone shifts

sound_design.description: Immersive audio through layered sound design

sfx_types.use: Emphasis on key words or visuals
Build tension/anticipation. ONLY before genuinely important moments.
Release tension, emphasize major moments. Pair with risers.
Create mystery and suspense. Background layer for tense sections.

music_strategy.description: Choose songs that match the mood of each segment (anticipation, innovation, excitement, dread)
Separate video by subject changes, assign appropriate mood to each
Abruptly pause music for special moments — jolts attention
Slowly fade music out to signal segment endings — creates anticipation
Sync music hits/dips to video events (problem section has different energy than solution)
Download separate song elements (stems) for precise control over drums, melody, bass

production_polish.description: Making the video look professionally produced
techniques: Subtle particle animations (dust, fog) for atmosphere
Consistent font and graphic style throughout

editing_quality.description: Score the editing quality of a finished video

criteria.name: cut_frequency
criteria.description: New visual element every 5 seconds or less?

criteria.name: b_roll_ratio
criteria.description: B-roll used for majority of video? A-roll reserved for important moments?

criteria.name: sfx_density
criteria.description: Appropriate SFX (whoosh, highlight, riser, hit, drone) at key moments?

criteria.name: music_mood_match
criteria.description: Music mood changes with content mood?

criteria.name: energy_variation
criteria.description: Clear energy shifts between sections? Not monotone?

criteria.name: graphics_animated
criteria.description: All graphics animate in (not just appear)?

criteria.name: attention_guides_used
criteria.description: At least 3 of the 6 attention guide techniques used?

criteria.name: no_dead_space
criteria.description: Zero moments where nothing visually interesting is happening?

anti_patterns.mistake: Same energy level throughout the entire video
anti_patterns.consequence: Viewer fatigue — even great content feels boring with monotone editing
anti_patterns.fix: Alternate between hype-edited sections and mellow A-roll

anti_patterns.mistake: Graphics appearing instantly without animation or sound
anti_patterns.consequence: Breaks immersion — viewer notices the editing
anti_patterns.fix: Animate every graphic in. Add a subtle whoosh or highlight sound.

anti_patterns.consequence: Trains the viewer to ignore tension signals — diminishes real reveals
anti_patterns.fix: Only use risers before genuinely important moments

anti_patterns.mistake: Using captions as subtitles rather than emphasis
anti_patterns.consequence: Visual noise — captions lose their punch when overused
anti_patterns.fix: 3 words or less, only for emphasis. Never to fill dead space.

anti_patterns.mistake: Visual variety that overwhelms instead of enhances
anti_patterns.consequence: Variety is like seasoning — too much ruins the experience
anti_patterns.fix: Healthy amount enhances. Mood should fluctuate but not chaotically.
